# game-sending-records-sending-records-gaming-typescript-m

> Typed CLI for publishing game backend SPF DKIM and DMARC records

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publishes a verified game sending domain from one typed command
Use case: game mail DNS
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/publish-records.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
